# Signal OS — Domain Glossary

**Generated by:** domain-glossary skill
**Purpose:** Ubiquitous language for all teams and stakeholders
**Version:** 1.0

---

## Core Domain Terms

| Term | Definition | Context | Notes |
|------|-----------|---------|-------|
| **Attention Intelligence** | The practice of using AI to predict and optimize how content captures audience attention | Company vision | Signal OS's core value proposition |
| **Content Scoring** | The process of evaluating a piece of content across 8 dimensions to produce a 0-100 score | Product | Core feature of Signal OS |
| **Scorecard** | The visual report showing a content's overall score and breakdown by dimension | Product UI | The primary user-facing artifact |
| **Dimension** | One of the 8 evaluated attributes of content (hook quality, readability, structure, emotional pull, timing, engagement likelihood, audience match, clarity) | Scoring engine | Plural: dimensions |
| **Hook Quality** | The effectiveness of a post's opening in capturing attention and compelling continued reading | Scoring dimension | Accounts for ~25% of overall score |
| **Emotional Pull** | The degree to which content triggers a specific emotional response (curiosity, relatability, inspiration, controversy) | Scoring dimension | Emotion drives shares |
| **Engagement Likelihood** | The predicted probability that a post will generate comments, retweets, and likes | Scoring dimension | Comments weighted higher than likes |
| **Sentiment Analysis** | NLP-powered classification of emotional tone in text (positive, negative, neutral, mixed) | Feature | Also tracks emotion breakdown |
| **Trend Forecasting** | AI prediction of which topics will grow in popularity over the next 24-72 hours | Feature | Uses velocity and acceleration signals |
| **Post Autopsy** | Retrospective analysis comparing a post's predicted score with actual performance | Feature | Diagnostic tool for learning |
| **Command Center** | Unified dashboard for scoring, scheduling, publishing, and analytics | Product UI | Central hub of the platform |
| **Content Queue** | Ordered list of draft and scheduled posts awaiting publishing | Product feature | Managed within Command Center |
| **Optimal Timing** | AI-calculated best posting time based on audience activity patterns | Feature | Personalized per creator |
| **Scoring History** | Record of all previously scored content with scores and trends | Product feature | Enables learning over time |

---

## Technical Terms

| Term | Definition | Used By |
|------|-----------|---------|
| **Scoring Engine** | Python FastAPI service that runs the 8-dimension content analysis | Engineering |
| **Model Inference** | The process of running content through the trained ML model to generate predictions | Engineering, Data |
| **Feature Extraction** | The process of converting raw text into numerical features the model can analyze | Engineering, ML |
| **Inference Latency** | Time from receiving content to returning a score | Engineering, SRE |
| **Correlation Score** | Statistical measure (Pearson r) of how well predicted scores match actual engagement | Data, Product |
| **Training Dataset** | The 2.3M posts with engagement labels used to train the scoring model | ML, Data |
| **Distilled Model** | Smaller, faster version of a large transformer model (maintains accuracy, reduces latency) | Engineering, ML |
| **Fine-tuning** | The process of adapting a pre-trained model to a specific task using labeled data | ML |
| **Prompt Engineering** | Crafting input structures to optimize LLM output quality | ML, Product |
| **Rate Limiting** | Controlling API request frequency to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage | Engineering |
| **JWT (JSON Web Token)** | Authentication token used for secure API access | Engineering |
| **OAuth 2.0** | Authentication protocol used for Google Sign-In and X account connection | Engineering |
| **Webhook** | HTTP callback triggered by events (e.g., post published, score completed) | Engineering, API |

---

## Business Terms

| Term | Definition | Used By |
|------|-----------|---------|
| **MAU** | Monthly Active Users — unique users who engage with the product in a 30-day period | Growth, Executive |
| **WAS** | Weekly Active Scorers — users who score at least 1 post per week (North Star Metric) | Product, Growth |
| **ARPU** | Average Revenue Per User — MRR divided by paying users | Finance, Growth |
| **CAC** | Customer Acquisition Cost — total sales & marketing spend divided by new customers | Growth, Finance |
| **LTV** | Lifetime Value — predicted total revenue from a customer over their relationship | Finance, Growth |
| **Free-to-Paid Conversion** | Percentage of free users who upgrade to a paid plan | Growth, Product |
| **Churn Rate** | Percentage of customers who cancel their subscription in a period | Finance, Growth |
| **MRR** | Monthly Recurring Revenue — predictable monthly revenue from subscriptions | Finance, Executive |
| **ARR** | Annual Recurring Revenue — MRR × 12 | Finance, Executive, Investors |
| **Net Revenue Retention** | (Starting MRR + Expansion - Contraction - Churn) / Starting MRR | Finance |
| **NPS** | Net Promoter Score — customer loyalty metric (-100 to +100) | Product, Growth |
| **Activation Rate** | Percentage of new users who complete the key action (first score) | Product |
| **Feature Adoption** | Percentage of active users who use a specific feature | Product |
| **Product-Market Fit** | The degree to which a product satisfies strong market demand | Executive, Investors |

## User & Role Terms

| Term | Definition | Notes |
|------|-----------|-------|
| **Creator** | A person who creates content on X (Twitter) for an audience | Primary user persona |
| **Solo Creator** | Individual creator managing their own account | Targets Pro plan |
| **Content Team** | Multiple people managing a brand or creator's content | Targets Team plan |
| **Agency** | Marketing agency managing multiple client accounts | Targets Team/Enterprise plan |
| **Brand** | Company using X for marketing and brand building | Targets Enterprise plan |
| **Power User** | Creator who scores 10+ posts per week | Highest value segment |
| **Casual User** | Creator who scores 1-5 posts per week | Conversion target |
| **Churned User** | Former paying customer who cancelled | Win-back target |

## X (Twitter) Platform Terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| **Impression** | Number of times a post is displayed to users |
| **Engagement** | Any interaction with a post (reply, retweet, like, bookmark) |
| **Engagement Rate** | Engagements ÷ Impressions × 100 |
| **Reply** | A response to a post (weighted highest by algorithm) |
| **Repost/Retweet** | Sharing someone else's post to your followers |
| **Bookmark** | Saving a post for later reference |
| **Follower Growth** | Net new followers in a time period |
| **Reach** | Number of unique accounts that saw a post |
| **Thread** | A series of connected posts by the same author |
| **Hook** | The opening line of a post designed to capture attention |
| **CTA** | Call to Action — prompt for reader response |

---

## Ambiguity Flags

| Term | Ambiguity | Resolution |
|------|-----------|------------|
| "Score" | Could mean scoring engine action OR the numerical result | Use "to score" (verb) vs "score" (noun, 0-100 value) |
| "Analysis" | Could mean sentiment, scoring, or trend analysis | Always specify: "content analysis" vs "sentiment analysis" |
| "Post" | Could mean X post or blog post | Default: X post. Use "blog post" for articles. |
| "User" | Could mean any account or paying customer | Use "free user" vs "paying customer" vs "active user" |
| "Dashboard" | Could mean main dashboard or specific feature dashboard | Specify: "main dashboard" or "sentiment dashboard" |
